description: Find and kill the Sword of Ma'at inside the Order fort atop Khabor's Pass. Speak with the Master Smith on the road to Khabor's Pass, he may know of a entrance into the Order camp. But before venturing off it may be wise to find other Guardians that will fight by your side.
name: Loyalty of the Guardians (MSQ)
completed: Return to Guardian Bart, in Highsteppe near the Airship dock, now that the Sworn sword of Ma'at has been defeated, and try to persuade him to join the cause.
